clips.summary: Viego dives a teamfight around the top-side river / Baron pit at 29:00 game time. He chains five kills, possessing each victim and resetting with Heartbreaker (R): rampage kill, double (Master Yi), triple (Caitlyn), then quadra and penta 0.4 s apart (zKeller, then Mordekaiser 'joobie'). He never dies, and his score goes 16/6/4 to 21/6/4 with a PENTAKILL banner.

kills.note: KDA 16->17 between 33.60 and 33.65; 'H3rmes is on a rampage!' banner at 33.70. Victim ('Major Noobman') is at Viego's spot, left of centre, inside a big cyan spell circle.
Master Yi. KDA 17->18 and DOUBLE KILL banner at 38.95. Big white-cyan Heartbreaker flash dead centre with +411 gold. The cleanest, most readable kill of the chain.

Caitlyn ('Jesster'). KDA 18->19 between 43.65 and 43.70; white flash and +399 gold right of centre. The TRIPLE KILL banner is delayed to 46.0 because it queues behind 'Ally slain' banners (43.2-45.7).
zKeller. KDA 19->20 between 47.05 and 47.10; huge '999' crit and +410 gold in the upper third, just under the TRIPLE KILL banner. The quadra banner never shows.
Mordekaiser ('joobie'). KDA 20->21 between 47.45 and 47.50. A giant cyan Viego R blast covers the upper-centre at 47.48. The PENTAKILL banner only appears at 48.6 (queued).

clips.camera: Steady follow on Viego (looks locked or near-locked). He stays roughly in x 0.35-0.6, y 0.4-0.6. No cuts or jumps. The background slides as he dashes from the pit edge into the jungle (~41-42 s). Kills 4-5 happen in the upper third of the screen.
clips.issues: The chain is long: 13.9 s from kill 1 to kill 5, with gaps of 5.3, 4.75 and 3.4 s, then 0.4 s. The gaps have constant fighting but no kills. Viego's possession swaps his model and HUD portrait to the victim's champion (35.5-38.2, 40.5-41.7, 45.0-46.6), which can confuse non-Viego viewers. The fight is a dense blob of spell effects and overlapping damage numbers. 'Ally slain' banners clutter the top centre from 43.2 to 45.7. The PENTAKILL banner arrives 1.1 s after the real 5th kill. Chat bottom-left fills with kill messages. Lowest HP is about 30% (713/2368) at 44.0-44.5, so this is not a near-death 'fall' clip.
clips.editor_notes: Best single moment: 47.0-47.6, quadra then penta 0.4 s apart with the huge cyan R blast at 47.48. Hold through 48.6-49.3 for the PENTAKILL banner. Zoom target for that beat: around (0.43, 0.25), upper-centre. Velocity-sync plan: slow down at 33.65, 38.92, 43.68 and 47.08/47.48, and run the gaps at 2-3x (34.2-38.5, 39.3-43.3, 44.0-46.8). That squeezes the penta into the 11.3 s drop. It is a finale contender too if no tighter pentakill exists, but its 14 s spread fits the drop's velocity ramp better than the 9.1 s finale. Kill 2 (38.92) is the cleanest centred hit to land on a downbeat. Put hits on the KDA-change times above, not on the banners, which are delayed. Optional overlay: the top-right KDA counts 16 -> 21. The approach at 29.6-32.6 (a calm walk through the river pit) could also serve as a short intro or hunt lead-in.

The marker is about 1.2 s early. KDA 5->6 is between 51.51 and 52.24, and +443 gold shows over a falling enemy at 52.24. The 50.9 burst is an ult dash, not the kill
KDA 6->7 between 53.71 and 54.44; +185 gold at 54.44

clips.camera: Locked on Akali. It pans constantly as she flips and dashes across the bridge (up-left at 47-49, down-left at 50.7-51.5). The action stays roughly centred but the background slides a lot.
clips.issues: The kills are spread out (49.0, 52.1, 54.2), with roaming in between. Akali is small, and the shroud makes her hard to see. The camera pans away right after (55.9 shows mostly trees).
clips.editor_notes: Kill 1 (shutdown under the tower, 48.6-49.3) is the cleanest single moment. For a tighter cut, use 51.3-54.7 (kills 2 and 3, 2.1 s apart). The SHUT DOWN! banner at 50.7 and the TRIPLE KILL! banner at 55.9 make good text hits. Ignore the marker at 50.91: the real kill 2 is at ~52.1.

clips.champion: Samira (default-style skin with headwrap; 'S' style icon)
clips.summary: Samira cleans up a messy teamfight. She gets a kill at the top of the screen, ults (orange ring at 51.1), then chases two more enemies down the bridge for a triple kill (KDA 16 -> 19).

kills.note: KDA 16->17 between 50.20 and 50.87; '743' hit with the enemy falling at 50.87; the R ring opens at 51.1
KDA 17->18 between 52.87 and 53.53; big '807' crit and '999' at 53.12. The 'You have slain an enemy!' banner (from kill 1) is up from 52.6
KDA 18->19 between 54.87 and 55.53; '650' at 55.12, +314 gold at 55.53. The DOUBLE KILL banner shows at ~55 (queued); no triple banner by 56.9

clips.camera: Follows Samira but drifts and re-centres a lot. The view shifts from the top-of-bridge fight (50-51.5) down to the centre circle (52-54) and then up-left to the tree area (54.6+), so the background changes noticeably between kills.
clips.issues: Kill 1 is in the upper third, inside a crowded blob. Champions are small, the multikill banners lag behind the real kills, and the chat log is busy at bottom-left.
clips.editor_notes: The best single frame is the R ring at 51.12 (orange circle, x 0.6 y 0.35) with the '999' pop; it makes a great beat-hit. Kills 2 and 3 land about 2 s apart and are well centred. For a star run, cut 52.5-55.6. Trust the KDA counter over the banners.

clips.champion: Viego (possesses enemies: Akali form ~35-42, a second enemy's form from ~43)
clips.summary: Viego gets a shutdown kill, possesses Akali, then reverts and gets two more kills about 2 s apart for a triple. Each kill swaps his body and HUD to the dead champion.

kills.note: KDA 13->14 between 34.32 and 35.32; fiery explosion at 34.32, +200 gold at 35.32; then the SHUT DOWN! banner (36-39)
KDA 14->15 between 41.32 and 42.32; a purple possession mist and beam erupt at 42.32 with +200 gold
KDA 15->16 between 43.32 and 44.32; +200 gold at 44.32, DOUBLE KILL! banner up from 42.8

clips.low_hp: Not during this chain (HP stays above ~50%). Unchecked: this low_health_kill clip also has a kill at ~54.3 and the user's death at ~55.3, which may be a low-HP kill right before dying.
clips.camera: Locked on Viego/champion and mostly centred. It moves steadily with him; no big jumps.
clips.issues: The dark Bilgewater map and small, busy figures make it hard to read. Kill 1 is 7 s before the other two, so only kills 2 and 3 work as a quick multikill. The HUD changes champion mid-clip, which is fine but may confuse non-players.
clips.editor_notes: Best moment: the possession burst at ~42.3 (purple beam and mist, x 0.46 y 0.4), right after kill 2. Then the red-gold ring at 43.3-45.3 around kill 3. Brighten or grade it up; it is very dark. If the lead needs a 'fall' candidate, check 53-55.3 for the low-HP kill that this clip was triggered on.

clips.champion: Ahri (pink-haired skin; Orb, Fox-Fire, Charm heart, Spirit Rush)
clips.summary: An 0/3/10 Ahri turns a fight with a quick triple kill in about 2.5 s, charming and orbing three enemies near the centre circle. The TRIPLE KILL! banner shows at 56.3.

kills.note: KDA 0->1 between 52.69 and 53.29; red burst and +250 gold at the top-right of the fight at 53.29
KDA 1->2 between 53.89 and 54.49; +185 gold and LEVEL UP over Ahri at 54.49
KDA 2->3 between 55.09 and 55.69; a charmed (pink) enemy dies with +373 gold at 55.69

clips.camera: Locked on Ahri and steady. The view drifts gently down-left between 52 and 53 as she backs off, then holds. The fight stays upper-centre.
clips.issues: The effects are modest (no big ult explosion), and the kills sit in the upper third (y 0.2-0.3), near the top banner. Champions are fairly small. HP dips to about 52% but is never near death.
clips.editor_notes: This is the cleanest and tightest triple of the batch: 3 kills in 2.5 s, with Ahri easy to follow. Use the KDA counter for exact beats (52.95 / 54.2 / 55.4). A 1.3x zoom centred on x 0.6 y 0.3 makes it pop. The TRIPLE KILL! banner at 56.3 is a good closing text hit. The big teal Spirit Rush ring at 51.5 makes a good entry.

clips.summary: Jinx is in a messy teamfight around the bridge cannon, with fire explosions around 48-49 s. She gets a double kill at 50.3 and 52.3, then gets focused (HP 1630 -> 588 between 52.2 and 53.4) and dies at about 53.7. The third 'kill' at 55.1 lands while she is dead and the screen is grey.

kills.note: KDA 10->11 between 50.2 and 50.4; enemy outlined red at 50.3, +166 gold at 50.5
KDA 11->12 between 52.2 and 52.4; +132 gold at 52.3; DOUBLE KILL banner from 52.5
posthumous: KDA 12->13 between 55.0 and 55.2 while Jinx is dead (grey screen). Time is solid, position is a guess

clips.low_hp: 52.6-53.6: HP falls 1188 -> 898 -> 588 of 2356 and she dies at about 53.7 (deaths 11->12, screen goes grey). She does not survive.
clips.camera: Follows Jinx, mostly steady with moderate panning. The fight sits in the lower-centre. Greyscale death screen from 53.7.
clips.issues: Heavy chat spam on the left. User dies at 53.7. Third kill happens while dead on a grey screen. Shop window covers the centre from about 56.0. Lots of minions and units crowd the fight.
clips.editor_notes: Markers run about 0.5 s early here. The best single beat is the 52.3 double kill (DOUBLE KILL banner at 52.5); zoom to about (0.46, 0.68). The fire explosion at 48.7 makes a good lead-in. Cut before 53.6 so the grey death screen never shows, and avoid everything after 53.7.

clips.summary: Ashe gets two kills at 10.7 and 14.15 in a crowded fight around the upper-left tower area, with golden beams flying around. Later she pokes at about 10% HP (281/2728) from 52 s and gets a long-range kill at 55.45 while still that low, then survives.

kills.note: KDA 11->12 between 10.6 and 10.7; pink burst at left, +184 gold at 10.8. Banner shows an unrelated SHUT DOWN!
KDA 12->13 between 14.0 and 14.2, inside a blob near the top; camera jumps right after
low-HP kill: KDA 13->14 between 55.4 and 55.5 with Ashe at about 10% HP. The camera snaps at 55.4 and the victim isn't clearly visible

clips.low_hp: From about 52 s to the clip end Ashe sits at about 10% HP (281-290/2728). She kills an enemy at 55.45 and survives, but the only sign on screen is the HUD bar.
clips.camera: Unlocked, pans a lot and jumps (big jump at 14.2-14.4, snap at 55.4). The action often sits near the top or left edge.
clips.issues: Banners are queued and stale (SHUT DOWN / 'You have slain an enemy' don't line up with her kills). Fights are small blobs near the frame edges. Chat on the left. The 52-56 low-HP section is spread-out poke with no clear target.
clips.editor_notes: This is a weak clip; use it only as filler. If used: 10.67 kill at left (0.32, 0.36), then 14.15 at top-centre (0.5, 0.22), cutting before the 14.2 camera jump. Possible backup for 'fall' is 53.5-56.0 (10% HP kill at 55.45 with Ashe's crystal-arrow cast bar visible at 54.0), but it reads poorly without a HUD zoom on the HP bar.

clips.summary: Lucian (KDA 6/19, team losing) takes a kill at 20.35 inside a huge orange hex dome with pink ribbons, then after 5 s of walking a second kill at 27.55 on the upper-right edge, which is announced as DOUBLE KILL. HP never goes below about 31%. The DOUBLE/TRIPLE KILL banners at 16-17 s belong to an enemy Miss Fortune.

kills.note: KDA 6->7 between 20.3 and 20.4; +121 gold and 486 damage at 20.4 inside the orange dome
KDA 7->8 between 27.5 and 27.6; 581 damage and +167 gold near the right edge; DOUBLE KILL banner at 27.65

clips.camera: Pans with Lucian. The fight moves from upper-centre (20 s) to the upper-right edge (27.5 s). Mostly walking between 21 and 26.
clips.issues: Kills are 7 s apart with dead time between. The second kill is off to the right edge next to the scoreboard portraits. The 'low_health_kill' tag is misleading: HP is about 36% at the kill. The multikill banners at 16-17 s are an enemy's. Chat on the left.
clips.editor_notes: The flashy shot is 19.6-20.8: the orange hex dome and pink swirl peak right on the 20.35 kill. Zoom to about (0.55, 0.33). If a second shot is needed, use 27.1-27.9 and re-centre the zoom right to about (0.8, 0.28) for the DOUBLE KILL. Skip 21-26.

clips.summary: Master Yi, with Highlander active ('Can't Be Slowed!'), takes a triple kill near the centre of the screen: 48.45, 52.15 (DOUBLE KILL plus level up) and 55.25 (TRIPLE KILL). He stays at 36-50% HP throughout.

kills.note: KDA 14->15 between 48.4 and 48.5; +112 gold at 48.4; 'Art3m1s is on a killing spree' banner
KDA 15->16 between 52.1 and 52.2; +200 gold and LEVEL UP at 52.2-52.3; DOUBLE KILL banner
KDA 16->17 between 55.2 and 55.3; +200 gold at 55.3, dead centre; TRIPLE KILL banner around 55.4-56

clips.camera: Mostly centred on Yi, with one big recentre snap between 51.8 and 51.9.
clips.issues: Kills are about 3.5 s apart, so it is a steady triple rather than a burst. Yi's effects are modest (no huge explosions). A purple ground circle (an ally's zone) sits under the fight. Chat on the left.
clips.editor_notes: Cleanest centred multikill of this batch. The best single beat is 55.25 at dead centre (0.5, 0.45) with TRIPLE KILL following. For a fast star cut, take three short hits: 48.1-48.7, 51.9-52.5 (cut through the 51.85 camera snap), and 54.95-55.6. The +200 gold pop-ups land about 0.05 s after each kill.

clips.map: ARAM-style single lane, pink spirit-blossom variant (not Howling Abyss)
clips.summary: AP Malphite gets a kill at 33.85 with a blue pillar and huge orange explosions, then a second at 43.75 (DOUBLE KILL). Right after, his HP drops to about 15% (446/3034) and stays there. He gets another kill at 54.95 while still at 15%, and his team gets an ACE at about 56.

kills.note: KDA 17->18 between 33.8 and 33.9; 'You have slain an enemy' plus a big orange explosion and blue pillar at 33.9-34.1
KDA 18->19 between 43.7 and 43.8; +200 gold at 43.9; DOUBLE KILL banner at 43.9
low-HP kill: KDA 19->20 between 54.9 and 55.0 with Malphite at 452/3034 (15%); ACE banner from about 56.0

clips.low_hp: HP drops from about 1066 to 463/3034 at 44.0-44.4 and stays around 15% until the clip ends. He gets a kill at 54.95 at 15% HP, the team ACEs at 56, and he survives. Only the HUD bar shows it (no red screen).
clips.camera: Pans steadily with Malphite. The fights sit in the upper-middle.
clips.issues: A 'Connect to League Voice' popup sits at right-centre above the minimap. Chat on the left. Fights are colourful but cluttered. The 33.85 and 43.75 kills are 10 s apart. Low HP is only visible on the HUD.
clips.editor_notes: For 'fall': 53.6-56.3, with the slow-mo landing on the 54.95 kill at about (0.62, 0.33). A HUD inset or zoom on the HP bar (bottom-centre, 452/3034) sells the near-death. Alternative 'hunt' shot: 33.3-34.3. The 33.9-34.1 explosion with the blue pillar is the most spectacular frame in this clip; zoom to about (0.47, 0.55). Markers vary by about 0.5 s in both directions.

clips.summary: A giant 36k-HP Sejuani gets a slow triple kill: 38.45 ('is legendary!'), 45.05 (DOUBLE KILL, then a big green Winter's Wrath swirl), and 52.65 (TRIPLE KILL near the tower). She is never in danger.

kills.note: KDA 18->19 between 38.4 and 38.5; +200 gold and 714 damage at 38.5; 'Art3m1s is legendary!' banner
KDA 19->20 between 45.0 and 45.1; +200 gold at 45.1; green swirl bursts at 45.3-45.5; DOUBLE KILL
KDA 20->21 between 52.6 and 52.7; 1415 damage and +108 gold near the top as Sejuani charges up; TRIPLE KILL banner

clips.camera: Centred on the huge Sejuani model and recentres between kills. Easy to follow.
clips.issues: Kills are about 7 s apart, so it's a slow triple with walking between. A tank kill feels less 'rock star' than a carry. Chat on the left.
clips.editor_notes: The best single beat is 45.05 followed by the green Winter's Wrath swirl at 45.3-45.5 (big, centred, about (0.57, 0.38)). The 37.8-38.9 kill with the purple slash and 'legendary' banner also reads cleanly. The model is large, so a light zoom (1.2x) is enough. Don't use it as a rapid 'star' chain: the gaps are too long.
